subject.title: fix(nostr): keep profile imports as cancellable drafts

question: Should Control UI's Import from Relays action stop persisting immediately and require explicit Save & Publish while explicit HTTP `autoMerge: true` callers remain unchanged?
rationale: The implementation coherently fixes cancellation and stale-response races, but it deliberately changes an established user interaction that requires owner intent.

options.title: Adopt draft imports
options.body: Confirm Import as a cancellable review-only action and retain Save & Publish as the sole Control UI persistence step.

options.title: Preserve immediate persistence
options.body: Retain the existing Control UI auto-merge interaction and rework the fix around narrower stale-response and cancellation protection.

recommendation.title: Adopt draft imports
recommendation.body: Confirm Import as a cancellable review-only action and retain Save & Publish as the sole Control UI persistence step.

likelyOwner.reason: The original Nostr feature history makes this the strongest available owner for the interaction-contract decision.
